cow.name: Cow King portal
cow.remainsDescription: After clearing the Dark Wood on Normal, recover Wirt's Leg from the ruined-village remains. Recovery grants no reward.
cow.used: Consumed to open the Cow portal
cow.retry: Defeat or abandonment grants no Cow income. The open portal allows a free retry.

stage.unavailable: Cow actions are unavailable. Track the quest and return on Normal when ordinary actions are ready.
stage.need-leg: Recover Wirt's Leg after clearing the Dark Wood on Normal.
stage.need-tome: At Akara, explicitly Receive the free bound portal Tome. Talking alone grants no ingredient.
stage.need-cube: Recover the actual Horadric Cube through its existing quest. Cow actions do not provide a Cube.
stage.ready-to-open: At Akara, Transmute both owned ingredients with the retained Cube. Opening grants no XP or loot.
stage.portal-open: The portal is open. Defeat the Cow King before claiming the separate quest reward.
stage.victorious: The Cow King is defeated and the portal is closed. Return to Quests to Claim the one-time 6,000 XP reward.
stage.claimed: The portal is permanently closed and the fixed quest reward has already been claimed.

source.unavailable: Unavailable; follow the current quest instruction.

feedback.already-read: This source has already been used.
feedback.already-opened: The Cow portal has already been opened.
feedback.not-eligible: The required source, location or quest state is not ready.
feedback.not-ready: Wait for the save to finish loading.
feedback.no-player: Create or continue a hero first.
feedback.combat-active: Finish or leave the active battle first.
feedback.claim-in-progress: Another quest action is still resolving.
feedback.unknown-area: This location does not support the Cow action.
feedback.grant-failed: The action failed. Check the current sources before retrying.
feedback.busy: Wait for the current battle or save action to finish.
feedback.restoration-failed: The action could not fully restore its changes. Check the current state before continuing.
feedback.refused: Cow portal entry was refused. Return on Normal with a valid open portal and no active battle.

act3-break-compelling-orb.name: Compelling Orb
act3-break-compelling-orb.description: Use Khalim’s Will to break the Orb in Travincal. The Will is consumed; the Cube is retained. This action grants no XP and can be performed before or after claiming Khalim’s Will quest rewards.
act3-break-compelling-orb.ready: Khalim’s Will is ready. Break the Orb to open the way to the Durance of Hate.
act3-break-compelling-orb.unavailable: Track The Guardian, visit Travincal, and assemble Khalim’s Will first.
act3-break-compelling-orb.consumed: Orb broken. Khalim’s Will was consumed, and the way to the Durance of Hate is open. Defeat Mephisto, then claim The Guardian reward separately in Quests.

act4-shatter-soulstone.name: Hellforge
act4-shatter-soulstone.description: Shatter Mephisto’s Soulstone at the Hellforge. This consumes both the recovered Hellforge Hammer and the Soulstone granted by The Guardian. Shattering grants no XP; claim Hell’s Forge rewards separately in Quests.
act4-shatter-soulstone.ready: Both the Hellforge Hammer and Mephisto’s Soulstone are owned and ready to be consumed.
act4-shatter-soulstone.unavailable: Track Hell’s Forge, defeat Hephasto, recover the hammer, and bring the Soulstone claimed from The Guardian to the River of Flame.
act4-shatter-soulstone.consumed: Soulstone shattered. Both the Hellforge Hammer and Mephisto’s Soulstone were consumed. Claim Hell’s Forge rewards separately in Quests.

act5-release-barbarian-cage-1.name: Prisoner cage 1
act5-release-barbarian-cage-1.description: Release this group of five prisoners after clearing the Frigid Highlands. Each cage can be opened once.
act5-release-barbarian-cage-1.ready: Area clear secured. This group is ready to be freed.
act5-release-barbarian-cage-1.unavailable: Track Rescue on Mount Arreat and clear the Frigid Highlands first.
act5-release-barbarian-cage-1.consumed: Five prisoners freed from this cage.

act5-release-barbarian-cage-2.name: Prisoner cage 2
act5-release-barbarian-cage-2.description: Release this group of five prisoners after clearing the Frigid Highlands. Each cage can be opened once.
act5-release-barbarian-cage-2.ready: Area clear secured. This group is ready to be freed.
act5-release-barbarian-cage-2.unavailable: Track Rescue on Mount Arreat and clear the Frigid Highlands first.
act5-release-barbarian-cage-2.consumed: Five prisoners freed from this cage.

act5-release-barbarian-cage-3.name: Prisoner cage 3
act5-release-barbarian-cage-3.description: Release this group of five prisoners after clearing the Frigid Highlands. Each cage can be opened once.
act5-release-barbarian-cage-3.ready: Area clear secured. This group is ready to be freed.
act5-release-barbarian-cage-3.unavailable: Track Rescue on Mount Arreat and clear the Frigid Highlands first.
act5-release-barbarian-cage-3.consumed: Five prisoners freed from this cage.

act5-inspect-anya.name: Frozen Anya
act5-inspect-anya.description: Inspect Anya in the Crystalline Passage, then visit Malah in Harrogath for her potion. No area clear is needed to inspect.
act5-inspect-anya.ready: Anya is within reach. Inspect the ice around her.
act5-inspect-anya.unavailable: Track Prison of Ice and visit the Crystalline Passage.
act5-inspect-anya.consumed: Anya inspected. Ask Malah in Harrogath for her potion.

act5-receive-malah-potion.name: Malah’s rescue potion
act5-receive-malah-potion.description: Receive the actual potion, then return to frozen Anya in the Crystalline Passage. Receiving it grants no quest reward.
act5-receive-malah-potion.ready: Anya inspected. Malah has one potion for you.
act5-receive-malah-potion.unavailable: Track Prison of Ice and inspect frozen Anya first.
act5-receive-malah-potion.consumed: Potion received. Take it to Anya in the Crystalline Passage.

act5-thaw-anya.name: Thaw Anya
act5-thaw-anya.description: Use Malah’s Potion on Anya. The potion is consumed. Then defeat Nihlathak in the Crystalline Passage and claim your quest reward separately.
act5-thaw-anya.ready: Malah’s Potion is ready to thaw Anya.
act5-thaw-anya.unavailable: Inspect Anya, then receive Malah’s Potion in Harrogath and bring it here.
act5-thaw-anya.consumed: Anya thawed. Defeat Nihlathak, then claim the personalization charge and Scroll of Resistance in Quests. Read the scroll in Inventory.

areaObjects.title: Area Objects
areaObjects.ready: The journal is ready to read.
areaObjects.unavailable: Track the quest and complete its earlier objectives before reading.

delivery.ready: Clear secured. Recover this quest item.
delivery.unavailable: Track the quest, complete its earlier objectives, and clear this area first.
delivery.owned: Item recovered. Give it to the named NPC in town.
delivery.consumed: Item delivered. This item can only be given once.

khalims_heart.name: Khalim’s Heart
khalims_heart.owned: Recovered. Retain this ingredient until assembly.
khalims_heart.unavailable: Track Khalim’s Will and clear this area first.

khalims_brain.name: Khalim’s Brain
khalims_brain.owned: Recovered. Retain this ingredient until assembly.
khalims_brain.unavailable: Track Khalim’s Will and clear this area first.

khalims_eye.name: Khalim’s Eye
khalims_eye.owned: Recovered. Retain this ingredient until assembly.
khalims_eye.unavailable: Track Khalim’s Will and clear this area first.

khalims_flail.name: Khalim’s Flail
khalims_flail.owned: Recovered. Retain this ingredient until assembly.
khalims_flail.unavailable: Track Khalim’s Will, clear Travincal and defeat its High Council first.

horadric_cube.name: Horadric Cube Coffer
horadric_cube.ready: Recover the Horadric Cube from this coffer.
horadric_cube.unavailable: Track The Horadric Staff quest to recover the Cube.

staff_of_kings.name: Staff of Kings Chest
staff_of_kings.ready: Recover the Staff shaft from this chest.
staff_of_kings.unavailable: Track The Horadric Staff and recover the Cube first.

viper_amulet.name: Viper Amulet
viper_amulet.ready: Recover the Viper Amulet from the Serpent Altar.
viper_amulet.unavailable: Track The Horadric Staff and recover the shaft first.

hellforge_hammer.name: Hellforge Hammer
hellforge_hammer.ready: Hephasto defeated. Recover his hammer explicitly.
hellforge_hammer.owned: Hammer recovered. Bring it and Mephisto’s Soulstone to the Hellforge; shattering consumes both.
hellforge_hammer.consumed: Hammer consumed together with Mephisto’s Soulstone at the Hellforge.
hellforge_hammer.unavailable: Track Hell’s Forge and defeat Hephasto in the River of Flame first.

sun_cult_tome.name: Sun-Cult Tome Cache
sun_cult_tome.ready: Recover the Sun-Cult Tome. Claim Drognan’s knowledge reward separately in Quests.
sun_cult_tome.owned: The Sun-Cult Tome is safely kept in Quest Items.
sun_cult_tome.unavailable: Track Drognan’s Tome and visit the Lost City in Normal difficulty to recover it.

horazon_lockbox.name: Horazon's Lockbox
horazon_lockbox.ready: Recover Horazon's Lockbox. Claim XP and Manald Heal separately in Quests.
horazon_lockbox.owned: Horazon's Lockbox is safely kept in Quest Items.
horazon_lockbox.unavailable: Track Horazon's Lockbox and visit the Arcane Sanctuary on Normal difficulty to recover it.

elzix_strongbox.name: Elzix's Strongbox
elzix_strongbox.ready: Recover Elzix's Strongbox. Claim XP and The Eye of Etlich separately in Quests.
elzix_strongbox.owned: Elzix's Strongbox is safely kept in Quest Items.
elzix_strongbox.unavailable: Track The Lost Caravan and visit the Far Oasis on Normal difficulty to recover the strongbox.

nihlathak_relic.name: Nihlathak’s Relic Cache
nihlathak_relic.ready: Recover Nihlathak’s relic. Claim Cain’s reward separately in Quests.
nihlathak_relic.owned: Nihlathak’s relic is safely kept in Quest Items.
nihlathak_relic.unavailable: Track Nihlathak’s Treasure, free Anya and defeat Nihlathak, then recover the relic in Crystalline Passage on Normal difficulty.

cain_cage.name: Ruined-village cage
cain_cage.ready: Akara has deciphered the scroll. Free Cain from his cage.
cain_cage.unavailable: Recover the Scroll of Inifuss after clearing the Dark Wood, give it to Akara, then return to this cage.
cain_cage.completed: Cain is safe in the Rogue Encampment. Claim the quest reward separately.
cain_cage.excerpt: Cain is safe in town. Speak with him for his gratitude quest.

horazon_journal.name: Horazon's Journal
horazon_journal.completed: Journal read. Claim your quest rewards from Quests.
horazon_journal.excerpt: The journal identifies the true Tomb of Tal Rasha. The Lord of Pain awaits within.

serpent_altar.name: Serpent Altar
serpent_altar.ready: Destroy the Serpent Altar to end the eclipse.
serpent_altar.unavailable: Track The Tainted Sun to destroy this altar.
serpent_altar.completed: Altar destroyed. Claim the quest reward separately in Quests.
serpent_altar.excerpt: Sunlight returns to the desert. The amulet can be recovered separately.

diablo_seal_1.name: Chaos Seal 1
diablo_seal_1.ready: Open seal 1. Open all three in order before defeating Diablo for quest credit.
diablo_seal_1.unavailable: Track Terror’s End and open the earlier seals in order first.
diablo_seal_1.completed: Seal opened. The remaining seals and Diablo victory are separate quest steps.
diablo_seal_1.claimed: Seal opened. Terror’s End reward claimed.
diablo_seal_1.excerpt: The seal is broken. The seals record quest progress; entering the area and facing Diablo remain available independently.

diablo_seal_2.name: Chaos Seal 2
diablo_seal_2.ready: Open seal 2. Open all three in order before defeating Diablo for quest credit.
diablo_seal_2.unavailable: Track Terror’s End and open the earlier seals in order first.
diablo_seal_2.completed: Seal opened. The remaining seals and Diablo victory are separate quest steps.
diablo_seal_2.claimed: Seal opened. Terror’s End reward claimed.
diablo_seal_2.excerpt: The seal is broken. The seals record quest progress; entering the area and facing Diablo remain available independently.

diablo_seal_3.name: Chaos Seal 3
diablo_seal_3.ready: Open seal 3. Open all three in order before defeating Diablo for quest credit.
diablo_seal_3.unavailable: Track Terror’s End and open the earlier seals in order first.
diablo_seal_3.completed: Seal opened. The remaining seals and Diablo victory are separate quest steps.
diablo_seal_3.claimed: Seal opened. Terror’s End reward claimed.
diablo_seal_3.excerpt: The seal is broken. The seals record quest progress; entering the area and facing Diablo remain available independently.

feedback.not-ready: Save data is loading or being replaced. Try again when it finishes.
feedback.no-player: Create or load a character first.
feedback.combat-active: Finish or leave the current battle before interacting.
feedback.unknown-area: This object is not available in this area.
feedback.not-eligible: Track the quest and complete its earlier objectives first.
feedback.busy: A battle or save operation is in progress. Try again when it finishes.
feedback.claim-in-progress: A quest action is in progress. Try again when it finishes.
feedback.grant-failed: The quest action could not finish. Try again.
feedback.restoration-failed: The action could not finish safely. Check your quest progress and quest items before trying again.

orifice.name: Tal Rasha’s Orifice
orifice.ready: Insert the Horadric Staff. The Staff will be consumed.
orifice.unavailable: Track The Seven Tombs and assemble the Horadric Staff first.
orifice.consumed: Staff inserted. The chamber is open.

act5-siege-on-harrogath.name: Siege on Harrogath
act5-siege-on-harrogath.desc: Track this quest, then defeat Shenk in the Bloody Foothills. Claim 10,000 XP and a socket charge. At Larzuk, choose an eligible unsocketed item from your backpack to use the charge.
act5-siege-on-harrogath.obj1: Defeat Shenk in the Bloody Foothills

act5-rescue-on-mount-arreat.name: Rescue on Mount Arreat
act5-rescue-on-mount-arreat.desc: Clear the Frigid Highlands, then open its three prisoner cages. Each cage frees five different barbarians. Claim 8,000 XP, one skill point and permanent +5 resistance to all six damage channels.
act5-rescue-on-mount-arreat.obj1: Free all 15 barbarians from the three cages

act3-guardian.name: The Guardian
act3-guardian.desc: Use the real assembled Khalim’s Will to break the Compelling Orb in Travincal, then defeat Mephisto in the Durance of Hate. Claim the quest reward separately. Breaking the Orb grants no XP.

act3-blade-of-the-old-religion.name: Blade of the Old Religion
act3-blade-of-the-old-religion.desc: Recover the Gidbinn in the Flayer Jungle and give the sacred blade to Ormus.

act3-lam-esens-tome.name: Lam Esen’s Tome
act3-lam-esens-tome.desc: Recover Lam Esen’s Tome in the Kurast Bazaar and give it to Alkor.
act3-lam-esens-tome.obj2: Give Lam Esen’s Tome to Alkor

act1-sisters-to-the-slaughter.name: Sisters to the Slaughter
act1-sisters-to-the-slaughter.desc: Andariel, the Maiden of Anguish, has corrupted the Rogue Monastery. Descend through the Catacombs and slay her to free the Sisters and reopen the path east.

act1-den-of-evil.name: Den of Evil
act1-den-of-evil.desc: Cleanse the Den of Evil near the Rogue Encampment.
act1-den-of-evil.obj1: Slay all monsters in the Den

act1-sisters-burial.name: Sisters' Burial Grounds
act1-sisters-burial.desc: Lay Blood Raven's spirit to rest.

act1-search-for-cain.name: The Search for Cain
act1-search-for-cain.desc: Recover the Scroll of Inifuss in the Dark Wood, give it to Akara, then rescue Cain at the ruined-village cage. Claim the quest reward separately.
act1-search-for-cain.obj1: Recover the Scroll of Inifuss after clearing the Dark Wood
act1-search-for-cain.obj3: Rescue Cain at the ruined-village cage in the Dark Wood

act1-forgotten-tower.name: The Forgotten Tower
act1-forgotten-tower.desc: Challenge the Countess in the Dark Wood on Normal difficulty.

act1-tools-of-the-trade.name: Tools of the Trade
act1-tools-of-the-trade.desc: Recover Charsi's Horadric Malus from the Catacombs cache, then give it to her in the Rogue Encampment.
act1-tools-of-the-trade.obj1: Recover the Horadric Malus after clearing the Catacombs
act1-tools-of-the-trade.obj2: Give the Horadric Malus to Charsi

act1-andariel.name: Bounty: Andariel
act1-andariel.desc: Defeat Andariel in the corrupted Monastery.

act1-charsis-imbue.name: Charsi's Imbue
act1-charsis-imbue.desc: After giving Charsi the Horadric Malus, present an eligible normal weapon or armor unchanged. Claim a separate Imbue charge, then choose which item to imbue.
act1-charsis-imbue.obj1: Present an eligible normal weapon or armor to Charsi without consuming it.

act1-rogue-merc-unlock.name: Kashya's Recruit
act1-rogue-merc-unlock.desc: Defeat Blood Raven, then return to Kashya. Enlist or re-enlist a Rogue Scout — Trainee here in Normal, then Claim one-time ensure-owned support separately in your journal.
act1-rogue-merc-unlock.obj1: Enlist or re-enlist a Rogue Scout — Trainee at Kashya.

act1-cains-favor.name: Cain's Gratitude
act1-cains-favor.desc: For rescuing him from the Dark Wood ruined village, Cain will identify your unidentified items free of charge.
act1-cains-favor.obj1: Speak with Cain in the Rogue Encampment.

act1-gheeds-gamble.name: Gheed's Salvage Deal
act1-gheeds-gamble.desc: Gheed sees value in five marked salvage lots in the Cold Plains. Recover each on Normal, then Claim in Quests to exchange all five for 1,000 XP and 1 Gem Shard.
act1-gheeds-gamble.obj1: Recover 5 distinct Gheed salvage lots in the Cold Plains on Normal.

act1-pandemonium-cow-rumor.name: Whispers of the Cow King
act1-pandemonium-cow-rumor.desc: Recover Wirt's Leg after clearing the Dark Wood on Normal. At Akara, Receive a bound Portal Tome and transmute both with the retained Horadric Cube. Enter the hidden clearing for one Cow King battle, then Claim 6,000 XP separately after victory.
act1-pandemonium-cow-rumor.obj1: Recover Wirt's Leg from his remains after clearing the Dark Wood on Normal.
act1-pandemonium-cow-rumor.obj2: At Akara, transmute Wirt's Leg and the bound portal Tome using the retained Horadric Cube.

act2-radaments-lair.name: Radament's Lair
act2-radaments-lair.desc: Atma asks you to defeat Radament in the burial chamber beneath the Far Oasis.
act2-radaments-lair.obj1: Defeat Radament beneath the Far Oasis

act2-horadric-staff.name: The Horadric Staff
act2-horadric-staff.desc: Collect the parts of the Horadric Staff and combine them.
act2-horadric-staff.obj1: Recover the Horadric Cube from the coffer in the Dry Hills.
act2-horadric-staff.obj2: Recover the Staff of Kings from the chest in the Far Oasis.
act2-horadric-staff.obj3: Recover the Viper Amulet from the Serpent Altar in the Lost City.
act2-horadric-staff.obj4: Assemble the shaft and amulet in the Cube from Inventory.

act2-tainted-sun.name: The Tainted Sun
act2-tainted-sun.desc: Slay the Claw Viper priests and restore the sun.
act2-tainted-sun.obj1: Destroy the Serpent Altar in the Lost City.

act2-arcane-sanctuary.name: The Arcane Sanctuary
act2-arcane-sanctuary.desc: Defeat the Summoner and read Horazon's journal to locate Tal Rasha's tomb.

act2-summoner.name: The Summoner
act2-summoner.desc: Defeat the corrupted Horadrim known as The Summoner.

act2-duriel.name: Bounty: Duriel
act2-duriel.desc: Defeat Duriel inside the Tomb of Tal Rasha.

act3-golden-bird.name: The Golden Bird
act3-golden-bird.desc: Recover the Jade Figurine in the Spider Forest. Give it to Cain for the Golden Bird, then give the bird to Alkor. Claim the Potion of Life in Quests and read it in Inventory.
act3-golden-bird.obj2: Give the Jade Figurine to Cain for the Golden Bird
act3-golden-bird.obj3: Give the Golden Bird to Alkor

act3-blade-of-old-religion.name: Blade of the Old Religion
act3-blade-of-old-religion.desc: Recover the Gidbinn from the Flayer Jungle.

act3-khalims-will.name: Khalim’s Will
act3-khalims-will.desc: Recover the Heart in the Flayer Jungle, the Brain in the Great Marsh, the Eye in the Kurast Bazaar, and the Flail after defeating Travincal’s High Council. Recover the four parts in any order, then assemble them using the retained Horadric Cube anywhere. Claim the XP reward separately.
act3-khalims-will.obj4: Recover Khalim’s Flail after defeating the High Council
act3-khalims-will.obj5: Assemble Khalim’s Will in the Horadric Cube

act3-mephisto.name: Bounty: Mephisto
act3-mephisto.desc: Descend into the Durance of Hate and defeat Mephisto.

act4-fallen-angel.name: The Fallen Angel
act4-fallen-angel.desc: Track this quest before defeating Izual on the Plains of Despair. Claim 9,000 XP and 2 skill points separately in Quests.
act4-fallen-angel.obj1: Defeat Izual on the Plains of Despair

act4-hellforge.name: Hell’s Forge
act4-hellforge.desc: Track this quest and defeat Hephasto in the River of Flame, then recover his hammer. At the Hellforge, consume the hammer and Mephisto’s Soulstone together. Claim 7,000 XP, one rune reward roll, and 3 Gem Shards separately.
act4-hellforge.obj1: Defeat Hephasto in the River of Flame
act4-hellforge.obj2: Recover the hammer, then shatter the Soulstone at the Hellforge (consumes both)

act4-terrors-end.name: Terror’s End
act4-terrors-end.desc: Track this quest, open the three Chaos Sanctuary seals in order, then defeat Diablo. Early victories do not count toward this quest; the seals do not control battle access. Claim 25,000 XP and five Diablo quest reward rolls separately.
act4-terrors-end.obj4: Defeat Diablo after opening all three seals

act5-siege.name: Siege on Harrogath
act5-siege.desc: Track this quest, then defeat Shenk in the Bloody Foothills. Claim 10,000 XP and a socket charge. At Larzuk, choose an eligible unsocketed item from your backpack to use the charge.
act5-siege.obj1: Defeat Shenk in the Bloody Foothills

act5-rescue-anya.name: Rescue on Mount Arreat
act5-rescue-anya.desc: Clear the Frigid Highlands, then open its three prisoner cages. Each cage frees five different barbarians. Claim 8,000 XP, one skill point and permanent +5 resistance to all six damage channels.
act5-rescue-anya.obj1: Free all 15 barbarians from the three cages

act5-prison-of-ice.name: Prison of Ice
act5-prison-of-ice.desc: Inspect frozen Anya in the Crystalline Passage, get Malah’s potion in town, then return and use it to thaw her. Defeat Nihlathak there afterward. Claim 12,000 XP, a personalization charge and a Scroll of Resistance. Read the scroll in Inventory for permanent +10 resistance to all six damage channels.
act5-prison-of-ice.obj1: Inspect frozen Anya in the Crystalline Passage
act5-prison-of-ice.obj2: Get Malah’s potion in town, then use it at frozen Anya

act5-rite-of-passage.name: Rite of Passage
act5-rite-of-passage.desc: Track this quest and defeat Talic, Korlic and Madawc together in the Ancients’ Way while you survive. Claim 15,000 XP and one skill point.
act5-rite-of-passage.obj1: Defeat all three original Ancients in one victory

act5-eve-of-destruction.name: Eve of Destruction
act5-eve-of-destruction.desc: Defeat Baal’s five original minion waves in order during one uninterrupted challenge in the Throne of Destruction, then defeat Baal. Stopping, losing or reloading before the fifth wave discards partial progress. Claim 40,000 XP, five quest reward rolls, the Slayer of Baal title and Nightmare replay.
act5-eve-of-destruction.obj1: Defeat the five original minion waves in order during one run
act5-eve-of-destruction.obj2: Defeat Baal after completing the five-wave sequence

act1-sisters-burial-grounds.name: Sisters' Burial Grounds
act1-sisters-burial-grounds.desc: Kashya, captain of the Rogues, demands you destroy Blood Raven, a former sister now twisted into a champion of evil who raises the dead in the Burial Grounds.

act2-seven-tombs.name: The Seven Tombs
act2-seven-tombs.desc: Within the true Tomb of Tal Rasha, Baal's prison hosts the Lord of Pain himself: Duriel. Shatter the orifice with the Horadric Staff and slay him.
act2-seven-tombs.obj1: Place the Horadric Staff into the orifice in the true Tomb of Tal Rasha.

act2-greiz-merc-roster.name: Greiz's Roster
act2-greiz-merc-roster.desc: Complete Radament’s Lair and reach hero level 12. Enlist or re-enlist a Desert Merc — Blessed Aim at Greiz in Normal, then Claim one-time ensure-owned support separately. The Book of Skill need not be claimed or read.
act2-greiz-merc-roster.obj1: Enlist or re-enlist a Desert Merc — Blessed Aim at Greiz.

act2-fara-favored.name: Fara's Favor
act2-fara-favored.desc: After completing Radament's Lair, speak with Fara in Lut Gholein. Claim 1 gem-shard separately in Quests. For one gem fusion, supply 3 matching gems of the same type and quality; the shard covers its catalyst cost.

act2-lost-caravan.name: The Lost Caravan
act2-lost-caravan.desc: Recover Elzix's Strongbox in the Far Oasis on Normal. Keep it as a memento and claim XP and The Eye of Etlich separately in Quests.
act2-lost-caravan.obj1: Recover Elzix's Strongbox in the Far Oasis.

act2-drognan-tome.name: Drognan's Tome
act2-drognan-tome.desc: Recover the Sun-Cult Tome in the Lost City. Drognan will share its arcane knowledge; claim XP and a skill point separately in Quests.

act2-summoners-secret.name: Horazon's Lockbox
act2-summoners-secret.desc: Recover Horazon's Lockbox in the Arcane Sanctuary on Normal. Keep it as a memento and claim XP and Manald Heal separately in Quests.
act2-summoners-secret.obj1: Recover Horazon's Lockbox in the Arcane Sanctuary.

act3-asheara-merc.name: Asheara's Iron Wolves
act3-asheara-merc.desc: Unlock Act III and reach hero level 18. Enlist or re-enlist an Iron Wolf — Frozen Armor at Asheara in Normal, then Claim one-time ensure-owned support separately in your journal.
act3-asheara-merc.obj1: Enlist or re-enlist an Iron Wolf — Frozen Armor at Asheara.

act3-alkors-experiment.name: Alkor's Experiment
act3-alkors-experiment.desc: Recover three distinct glands in the Spider Forest on Normal. Claim in your journal exchanges all three for XP and five unallocated stat points.
act3-alkors-experiment.obj1: Recover 3 venom glands in the Spider Forest.

act3-jade-statuette.name: Jade Figurine Buyer
act3-jade-statuette.desc: Recover three distinct trinkets in Kurast Bazaar on Normal. Give all three to Meshif, then Claim XP and rune shards separately.
act3-jade-statuette.obj1: Recover 3 jade trinkets in Kurast Bazaar and Give them to Meshif.

act3-ormus-charm.name: Ormus's Charm
act3-ormus-charm.desc: Clear every wave of the Flayer Jungle on Normal in a manual run, then speak with Ormus in Kurast. Claim his enchanted charm: +20 Life and +10 Mana while equipped in your charm slot.
act3-ormus-charm.obj1: Clear every wave of the Flayer Jungle on Normal in a manual run.
act3-ormus-charm.obj2: Return to Kurast and speak with Ormus.

act4-tyraels-blessing.name: Tyrael's Blessing
act4-tyraels-blessing.desc: Having freed Izual's soul, Tyrael grants you an extra skill point and reflects upon Heaven's regret for the Fallen Angel.

act4-jamella-trade.name: Jamella's Stockpile
act4-jamella-trade.desc: Recover five distinct embers in the River of Flame on Normal. Claim in your journal exchanges all five for XP and one perfect gem.
act4-jamella-trade.obj1: Recover 5 Forge Embers in the River of Flame.

act4-halbus-soul.name: Halbu's Soulwork
act4-halbus-soul.desc: Halbu, the angelic armorer, offers to socket a piece of armor for those who shattered Mephisto's soulstone.

act5-larzuks-sockets.name: Larzuk's Hammer
act5-larzuks-sockets.desc: After defeating Shenk, present eligible unsocketed backpack gear to Larzuk unchanged. Claim the side-quest socket charge in your journal, then choose gear at Larzuk to add sockets.
act5-larzuks-sockets.obj1: Present eligible unsocketed backpack gear to Larzuk unchanged.

act5-anyas-gift.name: Anya's Gift
act5-anyas-gift.desc: After completing Prison of Ice and actually thawing Anya, speak with her in Harrogath. Claim permanent +10 resistance to all six damage channels and a separate personalization charge in Quests. Her two optional trades each cost 40 Scrap and 2000 Rune Shards, once per character.
act5-anyas-gift.obj1: Speak with Anya in Harrogath after completing Prison of Ice and actually thawing her.

act5-qual-kehk-merc.name: Qual-Kehk's Warband
act5-qual-kehk-merc.desc: After freeing all three prisoner groups, visit Qual-Kehk in Normal difficulty at hero level 35 or higher. Choose and explicitly Enlist or Re-enlist a Barbarian Recruit for free, then Claim the one-time reward here. Claim keeps an owned recruit or provides one if dismissed before Claim, preserving your fielded choice.
act5-qual-kehk-merc.obj1: Choose a Barbarian Recruit and confirm Enlist or Re-enlist at Qual-Kehk.

act5-malahs-elixir.name: Malah's Elixir
act5-malahs-elixir.desc: Recover five distinct lichens in the Ancients' Way on Normal. Claim exchanges all five for XP and +10 effective Vitality after the ordinary soft cap, without restoring Life.
act5-malahs-elixir.obj1: Recover 5 Frost Lichens in the Ancients' Way.

act5-nihlathaks-treasure.name: Nihlathak's Treasure
act5-nihlathaks-treasure.desc: After freeing Anya and defeating Nihlathak in Crystalline Passage, recover his hidden relic there. Keep it and claim Cain’s XP and Mara's Kaleidoscope separately in Quests.

bounty-act1-moor-cull.name: Blood Moor Cull
bounty-act1-moor-cull.desc: Accept this contract, then clear every wave in Blood Moor on Normal in a new manual battle. Claim 1 Gem Shard in Quests, then choose Repeat for another cull. Battle XP and loot are separate.
bounty-act1-moor-cull.obj1: After Accept or Repeat, complete one new Normal manual clear of Blood Moor.

bounty-act2-waste-cull.name: Rocky Waste Cull
bounty-act2-waste-cull.desc: Accept this contract, then clear every wave in Rocky Waste on Normal in a new manual battle. Claim 1 Gem Shard in Quests, then choose Repeat for another cull. Battle XP and loot are separate.
bounty-act2-waste-cull.obj1: After Accept or Repeat, complete one new Normal manual clear of Rocky Waste.

bounty-act3-forest-cull.name: Spider Forest Cull
bounty-act3-forest-cull.desc: Accept this contract, then clear every wave in Spider Forest on Normal in a new manual battle. Claim 1 Gem Shard in Quests, then choose Repeat for another cull. Battle XP and loot are separate.
bounty-act3-forest-cull.obj1: After Accept or Repeat, complete one new Normal manual clear of Spider Forest.

bounty-act4-steppes-cull.name: Outer Steppes Cull
bounty-act4-steppes-cull.desc: Accept this contract, then clear every wave in Outer Steppes on Normal in a new manual battle. Claim 1 Gem Shard in Quests, then choose Repeat for another cull. Battle XP and loot are separate.
bounty-act4-steppes-cull.obj1: After Accept or Repeat, complete one new Normal manual clear of Outer Steppes.

bounty-act5-foothills-cull.name: Bloody Foothills Cull
bounty-act5-foothills-cull.desc: Accept this contract, then clear every wave in Bloody Foothills on Normal in a new manual battle. Claim 1 Gem Shard in Quests, then choose Repeat for another cull. Battle XP and loot are separate.
bounty-act5-foothills-cull.obj1: After Accept or Repeat, complete one new Normal manual clear of Bloody Foothills.

denOfEvil.desc: Cleanse the nearby Den of Evil.
denOfEvil.obj1: Slay all monsters in the Den

jade.description: Give all three trinkets together. This hand-in consumes them; Claim XP and rune shards separately in your journal.
jade.journal: Recover all three trinkets, Give them to Meshif in Kurast on Normal, then Claim the reward here.
